How GLP-1 works

A hormone your body already makes — in a steady, weekly dose.

Quiets food noise

Helps you feel full sooner and stay full longer.

Steadies blood sugar

Fewer spikes and crashes means fewer cravings.

Adjusted as you progress

Your provider tunes your dose with 1:1 check-ins.

faqs.question: Is GLP-1 safe for me?
faqs.answer: Your provider reviews your health history before prescribing, and prescribes only if treatment is right for you.

faqs.question: What side effects should I expect?
faqs.answer: Your provider goes through possible side effects with you before you start, and you can message them at any time.

faqs.question: Can I pause or cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: Message your care team from your patient portal and they’ll help you change your plan.
